ci.ownershipReconciliation: Historical exclusive-dispatch windows are planning rules; current mission47 instruction forbids dispatch, session45 handles checks, S0 retains final acceptance. No workflow, ref, validator or CI move by this reviewer.
constraints: Eight minimum recipes remain required, plus all additional epic/AGENTS affected-package gates. This is not a claim to a global Orchestra suite.
APP-SRC and APP-BROWSER are distinct full Bun selections; Playwright cannot replace them. Each Playwright job uses one worker.

Exact source, validator, runtime, config, fixture and selection identity is part of deduplication. Adopt only the same key with complete observed selection, valid Omni, intact artifacts and no later invalidation.

Setup or runner failure remains BLOCKED; test failure goes to the change owner. Prior regression needs reproducible comparison and attribution without a gate waiver. Zero tests, mismatched selection or missing artifacts cannot PASS.

Changes to product, tests, fixtures, config, skills, contracts or normative guides create a new C. Run affected consumers and retain cumulative required coverage of the same final C. A union of partial selections never substitutes for a full run.
Native/live proof uses the actual configured host, model, scanner and Atlas on the same C. Deterministic source checks cannot replace AM proofs.
Review findings go immediately to the active writer; reviewers do not edit product. Three final independent reviewers must be fresh after builders close. This helper review is not that campaign gate.

productAcceptance: C06 keeps immutable observed scope/version separate from current validity. The fingerprint excludes irrelevant global version and timestamps, and includes material data, absence and dependencies. Material changes cause stale state; revocation causes unavailable state; history is not rewritten.

C10 inventory cannot be reduced. An omitted category derives missing-category; explicit sourced zero remains distinct from unknown. A component is counted once even if it covers multiple categories. Reconciled arithmetic does not imply complete coverage.

Literal numeric cases remain: renewal 240000; base 210000; cost 235000 when implementation is 70000; subtotal 210000 with training omitted; total 250000, difference -10000 and threshold 15000 after training 40000 is confirmed; total 210000 with explicit zero. A conditioned human choice is not approval and survives later producer recalculation.
Digital PDF, DOCX and text extraction belongs to WP06; WP09 consumes the same C14 evidenceRef. A candidate is not a confirmed fact. Revocation, updates and removal remain visible.

Eighteen skills require version, digest, actual loading, effective model, persisted output and an actual consumer after reload. Catalogue presence, chat or a trace alone fails. Thirty-nine positive operation routes retain typed producers, grants and negative cases.
residentRuntime: The private per-call bridge requires actual Request authority, exact session, case, incarnation, profile, skill and current grants. Its consumed CallLease binds operation, payload digest, callId, generation and expiry of at most five minutes. Actor arguments cannot grant authority.

One logical sucafina-workbench has eight packs and 39 operations. Homonymous providers and substituted objects or generations cause conflicts. There is no global actor or provider-by-name fallback. Authentication is revalidated before and after the domain call and at egress.
The Revisor must run in a fresh SessionV2, without a fork of the analysis. Reusing the available model is allowed; reusing the same run is not independent review.

Atlas uses actual task/project templates, derived business owners and opaque evidence references. It does not fabricate engineering PRs or repository-store claims. The engine receives an authorized store facade; revoked entries are suppressed entirely and returns are revalidated.

Synchronous DurableMemory append stages the snapshot; the asynchronous SF transaction commit establishes durability. No success is declared before commit. Idempotent retry, reading after restart and current ACL remain required.
The real scanner distinguishes clean, hit and could-not-run. Unavailability cannot permit append; an always-clean mock is not proof. Native admission cannot be fabricated.
Real C07 routine admission is required. The routine-result entry mode denies prepare/run to prevent recursion. The model cannot choose its authority or entry mode.
atlasPackaging: The business-memory subpath exposes real factories, validators, fold and types, without scanners, spawning, dynamic imports or computed hiding. Native-memory preserves its bound exports and adds scanner exports without exposing unbound factories.

The canonical generator externalizes only the business-memory-ports descriptor, the exact normalized memory-emit.ts importer and literal ./scanner.js specifier to the public native-memory subpath. A missing or changed edge fails generation.
Nine Atlas paths belong exclusively to WP10.T07/S0-A; canonical generation produces four artifacts. Generated bytes receive no manual postprocessing; guards and allowlists are not weakened.

AST admission, generate, check:generated, typecheck and check:spawn-imports must run on the actual candidate with four artifact digests and guard/allowlist digests. Missing proof remains HOLD; AM05 scanner, commit, restart and ACL requirements remain.
